thread:
maria: heads-up — invoice-preview spiked for a handful of tenants this morning, looks like a +~1200 token delta compared to the shadow ledger. noticed around 08:12 UTC.
aj: ack, can you paste the tenant ids?
maria: tenant a1b2c3 and d4e5f6. spike correlated with a wave of cancelled in-flight requests (client-side aborts).
sam: do we still count tokens for cancelled requests? thought we only persisted on finalization.
maria: that's the thing — ingress accepted requests, runtime started decoding and kv cache allocated, then client sent cancel; the metering finalizer sometimes gets an orphaned partial event.
lee: repro steps? any logs?
maria: attaching short dump: 
```
2024-05-18T08:11:59Z INFO req=ch-9 decode.start tokens=1024
2024-05-18T08:12:00Z INFO req=ch-9 client.cancel
2024-05-18T08:12:00Z INFO req=ch-9 finalizer.emit tokens=1024 persisted=true
```
(more common is persisted=false but downstream dedupe missed it)
aj: if finalizer.emit persisted=true for canceled req that's bad. where's persisted flag set? finalizer checks `req.completed || req.force_flush`
sam: maybe we set force_flush on connection close and treat cancel as force_flush. older patch changed that to avoid leaking cache.
maria: exact — new behavior introduced in rollout 2024-05-10. rollout note said "ensure KV freed on abrupt disconnect" but accidentally toggled force_flush for cancel path.
lee: can we hotfix to gate force_flush with `if (cancel && !started_tokens)`? quick patch: 
```
if (req.cancelled && !req.decoded_tokens) {
  // drop finalizer emission
  return;
}
```
aj: cautious — some cancels happen after decode but before response; dropping could lose legitimate counts. we need to ensure idempotency in downstream metering.
sam: alternative: mark those events as `cancel_marker=true` and have aggregation dedupe ignore cancel_marker events when there's no completed event. cheaper to patch aggregator than runtime.
maria: aggregator change scope is larger — touches billing pipeline joins. runtime patch is localized and quick.
lee: agreed, patch runtime now, add a short integration test that simulates decode+cancel and asserts no persisted metering events.
aj: who owns deploy? maria can push patch to canary channel, we'll watch invoice-preview.
maria: will do. deploying to canary in 10. adding `@eng-sre` mention in deploy to monitor latency/preview deltas.
billing-bot: ALERT invoice-preview delta for tenants a1b2c3,d4e5f6 resolved in canary (post-deploy).
sam: nice. follow-up: we should add a unit-level contract: only finalizer emits metering events when `req.terminal_state == completed` OR `req.force_flush && req.decoded_tokens > 0 && !req.cancelled` — basically disallow force_flush on pure cancels.
aj: add that as a console doc change + a telemetry metric `metering.orphaned_events` incremented when we drop an event so we can monitor regressions.
maria: done. created PR #8421 with tests and a changelog entry. will promote to staged after 1h if canary looks green.
lee: schedule a small backfill check to remove the 1200 token artifacts from invoice-preview for the two tenants. ops?
aj: I'll run a one-off reconciliation job after patch promotes to staged, should be quick.
maria: thanks all. closing thread when promoted. :thumbsup:
